message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

The problem was in `vendor/slugify/index.js`. It deletes every character outside `a-z0-9`, so accented letters were dropped. That file is marked "do not edit by hand", so I left it alone. I fixed it in `src/blog/slug.js`, which now strips the accent marks from the title before passing it to slugify.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) call the same vendored function, so they still drop accented letters. I left them alone since you only asked about blog posts.
